title: The Broken Spire
author: H. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
